searchText: Hello, Is there anyone interested in ePBS? 🤗 I do! Me too <@&857649635274915900> Join us for another office hours presentation and AMA! This will be another special on, with 2 mentors this time. Advaita and Agnish from Nimbus will join us to present about the work on the client and share their experience from participating in the previous fellowship. Starting <t:1719327600:R>, details: https://github.com/eth-protocol-fellows/cohort-five/issues/96 Starting now! https://meet.ethquokkaops.io/epf-office-hours ePBS Office Hours #3 after chat I was trying to run kurtosis to connect to sepolia but it was giving me all sorts of errors. I am basically trying to run a lighthouse and prysm client pair but I dont have the hardware requirement for 2 client pairs. Anybody used kurtosis to connect to testnets? Kurtosis sepolia 👀 https://gist.github.com/karalabe/47c906f0ab4fdc5b8b791b74f084e5f9 Peter from geth just posted an interesting proposal Recording from today's office hours is up: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1aMKy9Vsud_njcbAyDN5CJuTA397JPCon/view?usp=sharing
